answers.system_description: CV screening tool for job applications

checks.requirement: Prohibition of AI systems that manipulate human behavior or exploit vulnerabilities in ways that cause harm
checks.rationale: The CV screening tool for job applications does not involve social scoring, biometric categorization, or manipulation of human behavior. The system is used for employment screening purposes only.
checks.source_citation: AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter applications, and to evaluate candidates

checks.requirement: Training, validation and testing data sets must be relevant, representative, free of errors and complete, with appropriate statistical properties
checks.rationale: Data governance is indicated as 'yes', but the questionnaire does not provide specific details about data quality criteria, representativeness, or bias minimization measures. The system affects employment decisions, requiring high data quality standards.
checks.remediation: Document and implement comprehensive data governance practices ensuring training, validation and testing datasets are relevant, representative, free of errors, complete, and designed to minimize bias that could lead to discrimination
checks.source_citation: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be relevant, representative, free of errors and complete. They shall have the appropriate statistical properties, including as regards the persons or groups of persons on which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

checks.requirement: Data sets must be designed to minimize bias and ensure sufficient representativeness of the target population
checks.rationale: While data governance is confirmed, there is no specific evidence of bias minimization strategies or verification that datasets represent the diverse population of job applicants across protected characteristics.
checks.remediation: Implement and document specific measures to minimize introduction of bias in training data and ensure datasets are sufficiently representative of all persons or groups on which the system will be used
checks.source_citation: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be designed and selected with a view to minimising the introduction of bias that could lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law and to ensuring that the data sets are sufficiently representative of the population or the target group for which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

checks.requirement: Data sets must account for geographical, contextual, behavioral or functional settings relevant to the intended use
checks.rationale: The deployment region is specified as EU, but there is insufficient information about whether training data accounts for specific geographical, contextual, or functional characteristics of different EU employment contexts.
checks.remediation: Ensure training, validation and testing data sets account for characteristics particular to the specific geographical, contextual, behavioural or functional settings within the EU employment context
checks.source_citation: Training, validation and testing data sets shall take into account, to the extent required by the intended purpose, the characteristics or elements that are particular to the specific geographical, contextual, behavioural or functional setting within which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

checks.requirement: Technical documentation must include system description, architecture, data sets, human oversight measures, and risk management
checks.rationale: Technical documentation is marked as 'partial', which is insufficient for a high-risk AI system in employment. Complete documentation covering system architecture, algorithms, data flows, training data specifications, and risk management is mandatory.
checks.remediation: Complete comprehensive technical documentation including: general system description, detailed architecture and algorithms, complete data set descriptions with sources and governance, human oversight measures, accuracy and robustness specifications, and risk management system documentation
checks.source_citation: The technical documentation shall contain, at a minimum, the following information, as applicable to the high-risk AI system concerned: (a) a general description of the AI system including its intended purpose, the name and contact details of the provider and, where applicable, its authorised representative; (b) a detailed description of the system architecture, including the algorithms, data flows, and processing operations; (c) a description of the data sets used for training, validation and testing, including information on data sources, data collection processes, and data governance practices

checks.requirement: Technical documentation must describe risk management system, accuracy metrics, and performance information
checks.rationale: With only partial technical documentation and partial accuracy testing, the system lacks complete documentation of risk management, performance metrics, accuracy, robustness, and known limitations required for high-risk employment AI systems.
checks.remediation: Document complete risk management system, provide detailed performance metrics including accuracy and robustness measures, document all known limitations and biases, and specify conformity assessment procedures
checks.source_citation: a description of the risk management system implemented in accordance with Article 9; (g) information on the performance of the AI system, including metrics for accuracy, robustness, and any limitations or known biases

checks.requirement: High-risk AI systems must be accompanied by instructions for use containing complete, correct and clear information for deployers
checks.rationale: Transparency measures are indicated as 'yes', but without complete technical documentation and full accuracy testing, the instructions for use may be incomplete regarding performance characteristics, limitations, and expected accuracy levels.
checks.remediation: Ensure instructions for use include: provider identity and contact details, system characteristics and capabilities, intended purpose, level of accuracy and robustness tested, known limitations, human oversight measures, and maintenance requirements
checks.source_citation: High-risk AI systems shall be accompanied by instructions for use in an appropriate digital format or otherwise that include concise, complete, correct and clear information that is relevant, accessible and comprehensible to deployers. The instructions for use shall contain at least the following information: (a) the identity and the contact details of the provider and, where applicable, of its authorised representative; (b) the characteristics, capabilities and limitations of performance of the high-risk AI system

checks.requirement: Instructions must specify accuracy, robustness levels, known circumstances affecting performance, and performance regarding target persons or groups
checks.rationale: Accuracy testing is only partial, which means instructions for use cannot fully specify the tested and validated accuracy levels, robustness against various circumstances, or performance across different demographic groups of job applicants.
checks.remediation: Complete comprehensive accuracy and robustness testing, then document in instructions: validated accuracy levels, robustness and cybersecurity measures, known circumstances impacting performance, and performance specifications for different groups of job applicants
checks.source_citation: the level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity against which the high-risk AI system has been tested and validated and which can be expected, and any known or foreseeable circumstances that may have an impact on that expected level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity; (iii) any known or foreseeable circumstance, related to the use of the high-risk AI system in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse, which may lead to risks to the health and safety or fundamental rights; (iv) its performance as regards the persons or groups of persons on which the system is intended to be used

checks.requirement: Instructions must describe human oversight measures and technical measures facilitating output interpretation
checks.rationale: Human oversight is confirmed as 'yes', indicating that oversight measures are in place. However, full compliance requires these measures to be clearly documented in the instructions for use with technical details on output interpretation.
checks.remediation: Ensure instructions for use clearly describe all human oversight measures and technical mechanisms that facilitate deployers' interpretation of the CV screening system outputs
checks.source_citation: the human oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate the interpretation of the outputs of the high-risk AI system by the deployers

checks.requirement: High-risk AI systems must be designed to enable effective human oversight to prevent or minimize risks to health, safety or fundamental rights
checks.rationale: The system has human oversight confirmed as 'yes', which is appropriate for a CV screening tool making automated decisions affecting employment. This allows human review of automated screening decisions that impact fundamental rights to work and non-discrimination.
checks.remediation: Document and maintain human oversight procedures ensuring HR personnel can effectively review, override, and intervene in automated CV screening decisions
checks.source_citation: a description of the human oversight measures implemented in accordance with Article 14

checks.requirement: High-risk AI systems must achieve appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout their lifecycle
checks.rationale: Accuracy testing is marked as only 'partial', which is insufficient for a high-risk employment AI system. Complete accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity validation is mandatory before deployment to ensure the system performs reliably across diverse applicant populations.
checks.remediation: Conduct comprehensive accuracy and robustness testing across diverse demographic groups, validate cybersecurity measures, establish performance benchmarks, and implement continuous monitoring to maintain appropriate accuracy levels throughout the system lifecycle
checks.source_citation: a description of the accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity measures implemented in accordance with Article 15; (g) information on the performance of the AI system, including metrics for accuracy, robustness, and any limitations or known biases

checks.requirement: Transparency obligations for general-purpose AI models and systems generating synthetic content
checks.rationale: The system is not a general-purpose AI model (gpai_model: no) and does not involve generative AI capabilities. Article 50 transparency requirements do not apply to this CV screening tool.
checks.source_citation: AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter applications, and to evaluate candidates

checks.requirement: Additional obligations for general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
checks.rationale: The system does not involve general-purpose AI models with systemic risk (systemic_risk: no, gpai_model: no). Article 51 requirements are not applicable to this employment-specific CV screening tool.
checks.source_citation: AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter applications, and to evaluate candidates
